```{r}

#this is for overweight vs vowel balance in VB dialects

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

folder_path <- "datasets/NDS_dataset"

NDS_data <- read.csv(
  file = file.path(folder_path, "a_class_dataset.csv"),
  sep = ";",
  header = TRUE
)

#filter for VB areas only and for prets only

NDS_data$`Dialect_area` <- iconv(
  NDS_data$`Dialect_area`,
  from = "latin1",
  to   = "UTF-8"
)

unique(NDS_data$`Dialect_area`)

filtered <- NDS_data %>%
  filter(
    Dialect_area %in% c("Midlandsk", "Troendsk", "Austlandsk", "Austlandsk/Midlandsk"),
    Cell == "preterite"
  )


lexeme_long <- filtered %>%
  filter(MN_class != "NA") %>%
  filter(MN_class %in% c("a", "e", "doubl a/e")) %>%
  mutate(
    class_collapsed = case_when(
      MN_class == "a"                 ~ "A-class",
      MN_class %in% c("e", "doubl a/e") ~ "E-class (including a/e doublets)",
    )
  ) %>%
  # counts per Lexeme and collapsed class
  group_by(Lexeme, class_collapsed) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # total per Lexeme and percentages
  group_by(Lexeme) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    perc  = 100 * n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

visualization <- lexeme_long %>%
  mutate(
    Lexeme = dplyr::case_when(
      Lexeme == "kasta" ~ "O kasta 'throw'",
      Lexeme == "kosta" ~ "O kosta 'cost'",
      Lexeme == "lika"  ~ "O lika 'like'",
      Lexeme == "maala"  ~ "O m\u00e5la 'paint'",
      Lexeme == "tapa"  ~ "VB tapa 'lose'",
      Lexeme == "kalla" ~ "O kalla 'call, name'",
      Lexeme == "takka" ~ "O takka 'thank'",
      Lexeme == "fiska" ~ "O fiska 'fish'",
      Lexeme == "lova"  ~ "VB lova 'promise'",
      Lexeme == "baka"  ~ "VB baka 'bake'",
      Lexeme == "bora"  ~ "VB bora 'drill'",
      Lexeme == "laga"  ~ "VB laga 'make'",
      TRUE              ~ Lexeme   # fallback if something is missing
    )
  )

p_byverb <- ggplot(visualization, aes(x = Lexeme, y = perc, fill = class_collapsed)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Inflectional class",
    values = c(
      "A-class"          = "#BDBDBD",
      "E-class (including a/e doublets)"   = "#2F2F2F"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Lexeme",
    y = "Percentage of forms"   
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 14)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "p_byverb.png",
  plot     = p_byverb,
  width    = 8, 
  height   = 5,
  units    = "in"
)

#overview per category overweight vs vowel balance

lexeme_long_OV <- lexeme_long %>%
  mutate(
    OV_cat = dplyr::case_when(
      Lexeme %in% c("kasta", "kosta", "lika", "maala", "kalla", "takka", "fiska") ~ "O",
      Lexeme %in% c("tapa", "lova", "baka", "bora", "laga")                       ~ "VB",
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(OV_cat)) %>%
  # counts per O/VB category and collapsed class
  group_by(OV_cat, class_collapsed) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(n),     
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # totals per O/VB category and percentages
  group_by(OV_cat) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    perc  = 100 * n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# visualization
ggplot(lexeme_long_OV, aes(x = OV_cat, y = perc, fill = class_collapsed)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4,
    color = "white"
  ) + scale_x_discrete(
    name   = "Verb group",
    breaks = c("O", "VB"),
    labels = c("Overweight", "Vowel balance")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  name   = "Inflectional class",
  values = c(
      "A-class"          = "#BDBDBD",
      "E-class (including a/e doublets)"   = "#2F2F2F"
    )
) +
  labs(
    x = "Verb group",
    y = "Percentage of forms"
  ) + theme_classic() +                                     
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )


```
